items.note: The plan gives the bit-case maps, the eight-row subtract/add/restore schedule, the central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side-wire cancellation, and the three-stage sequence (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), matching the proof at 741-763. It leaves out the complex-case gate maps, h=100, the formula for N and the wire counts W_b, W_c (764-781).

It states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, including auxiliary roles. It derives these by the paper's invariant: the stored array is D_v applied to the logical array, and the common frame commutes with the pointwise gate (804-822).

Every element of the statement is present: the bilinear forms, the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, the terminal sums N and Wm-N, the stage transitions, the central loss h, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal bases over F_2, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The verification that every edge joins comparable labels is only asserted: the gate-label table eq:motif-labels (985-994) and the per-edge residual table (1021-1044) are not given.

It derives M_v=P_U, the source matrix -P_{U_a}, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N extra rank-one first edges 2P_{U_a}, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint identity I_m, exactly as at 1156-1171. S3.3 supplies the Phi_M frames and the shear H<-H+D.

It follows the proof at 1231-1314: weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, each residual vector has odd weight, and H diag(1,-1) H = X gives aI+bX_v. It also covers the k-column tensor power, the exceptional pair X_a->Y_a with C^{-1} on its 27 coordinates corrected by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}, and the final C^{⊗m} on every role.

It gives s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m from L<N/2 (deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c), deficits above 20·2^{-50}, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}), and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. The exact values of eta_b and eta_c (1321-1324) and the fact log m<20 that justifies the middle inequality (1332-1333) are not given.
Both lemmas are stated with their O(V) costs and the b^{O(1)} offset condition. Their proofs are not reconstructed.

The shear is derived the paper's way: triangular transforms by controlled shifts, then each one of Pi done by D_j<-D_j+H_i, a swap and D_j<-H_i-D_j, giving exactly a interchanges. The pivot-elimination proof of the reversed Bruhat factorization (1374-1392) and the choice of an odd prime q avoiding all denominators (1412-1424) are missing.

It reconstructs each step of the proof at 1491-1615: the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} edges done by matrix shears with recursive calls, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D on every row, the three updates, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and the depth-first parking schedule.

It states O(Vu^tau) for u-bit chunks and gives the reduction: rho=O(log e) high digits as rows, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), and padding of binary ranges to [q^e]. The paper's exchange-and-join of the high parts that puts the row field before both chunks, and its reversal (1660-1684, 1708-1712), is compressed into 'peel off'.

It gives the product of directional kernels, conjugation by P_M with one child per slot, the inverse child identity (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c child calls on f=e/m axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, as at 1835-1940. The change of basis by a fixed number of row additions appears in S4.6.5.

The correctness argument matches the paper: eight packed additions with restored auxiliary w, the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, the union bound to delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, and repair by keyed stable radix sort. The lemma's time bound O(V(L^tau+1)+MA^3+delta_bad MA(R+A)) is never stated, and the cost derivation (2196-2203) and the final XOR at j_{f-1} are missing.

It covers the q_0 row chunks, the split u=Wg+w, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) for e<d^beta, the internal sum O(e^lambda), the leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the base-m partition giving d^{lambda'}, all as at 2306-2440.

It states Q_p(Hz) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error below sqrt2·2^{-p}, and derives the guard width from A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E to C_0 d^{C_1}=o(p). The proof's check that the packed lemma's hypotheses and cost hold uniformly (A_*<=C_A p, K/log p->∞, 2696-2730) is absent, and K=⌊d^c⌋ is not stated in S4.

It reconstructs character cancellation through y^{rj_0}=-1, decimation in frequency into bit-reversed order, the reversed procedure as half-inverses, the grouping into H and J_E, and the layout L of prefix moves and at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges. It ends with LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1} and the stated cost.
It uses B_0=2^{4p}, A_u=u(B_0) in 4pr bits, the bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2 for centered residues, and reduction mod y^r+1, all as at 3236-3335.
It derives the retained LB order commuting with the pointwise product, the normalization MF^+((F^-f)(F^-g)/r)=(f*g)/(rM), and the error 3delta+eta scaled to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, as at 3414-3460.

It follows the paper: the cited Gaussian identity and the bound on ||N-I||, a Neumann inverse, contraction normalizations giving A=S' and B_0=D'J'C, permutations kept in the identity, then tensoring with dp^2 error, line costs, and O(d^2) axis interchanges. S6.1.3 lumps the D' cost (see errors).
It derives chirp periodicity, the coefficient check for QF_t, the dilation identity F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+ giving RF^+R=F^+, and the cancellation to (u*v)/S^2, as at 3938-3980.

It gives every fixed exponent, the sizes and eq:sizes, alpha, gamma and eta, the Rosser-Schoenfeld prime count, Bernoulli giving T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p, the n^{o(1)} search, and the absence of wraparound, as in the paper.
It derives the isomorphism (the image of x has order S), the triangular formula b_i, updates in the order i=d..1 by prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).

The exact twist and M_C=D_-ι^{-1}M_r(ιD_+f,ιD_+g)=(f*g)/T are derived, and the computed sequence is listed. The computed version's derivation range 4349-4413 (phase approximations with error below 2·2^{-p}, formats, costs, sign-extension normalization) is not covered, and the twist error is never stated.
It gives the source transform (A, chirp transform, B_0, 2^gamma) with its exact counterpart RF_s, the conjugate opposite, the six-step algorithm, and the role of the two scales by S, as at 4434-4544.

It chains the disk margins and errors (.701, 8TL, E_s=9·2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), E_w<28·2^gamma T^2L) to the final bound 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, then rounding and the carry invariant. E_ring<5TL is implicit.
It reproduces the cost table, the margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional streams as o(Tp), polylog absorption, and the schoolbook cutoff.
S0 lists nlogn-conjecture only as a dependency. No step states that one machine with liminf T(n)/(n lg n)=0 negates the eventual lower bound, or that the bound gives limit zero.

errors.says: The two tape procedures are each driven by a finite linear network 'with total edge rank below its wire count'.
errors.paper: The saving is s<Wm, total edge rank below the wire count times m. s is close to Wm (deficit eta about 1.5e-11), far above W.

errors.says: Because the Gaussian window has radius ⌈√p⌉α, all three quoted maps S', J', D' cost O(tp^{3/2+δ}α).
errors.paper: The costs come from the cited lemmas, and D' costs O(tp^{1+δ}). The window radius only bounds the tape movement inside the S' procedure.

errors.says: Peel off the top rho digits of each chunk as a row index.
errors.paper: The high parts h^+, d^+ are first exchanged and joined, so that (d^+,h^+) forms a row field of range q^{2rho}>=W^k before both remaining chunks. The joining moves are reversed afterwards.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}): stream primitives, the two fixed networks with nested labels and s<Wm, the interchange and butterfly-layer recurrences with tau=1-2^{-50}, synthetic transforms, resampling with retained permutations, parameters and primes, exact recovery, and the cost table. It thins out in a few places: the gate-label and per-edge residual tables are asserted rather than shown, the Bruhat-type factorization is unproved, the packed lemma's time bound and the uniformity check in the layer proof are missing, and the negation of the n log n conjecture is never drawn.

steps.note: It has banks indexed by triples of 3-subsets, m=10^6, a fixed network giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and restoration of every scratch wire. It does not state h=100 or N=binom(h,3)^3 explicitly.
The common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs only a change of frame.
It has nondegenerate subspace labels in an m-dimensional tensor space, comparable labels on every edge, and central wires 3->4 as the only decreasing edges, each losing h.
It has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and the N negative source projections as exceptions whose first edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one.
It has sum |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, and the deficit N-2L_b>0, so s<Wm.
It has P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and 0->I on the other roles, so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
It has A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), deficits above 20·2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}), tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). log m<20 is used only implicitly.

central.summary: All nine central steps are reconstructed with their defining content and in their roles in the chain. The fixed bank-exchange network gets frames and nested labels, rank equals dimension change except for N rank-one source edges, the budget Wm-N+2L is below Wm because L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity gives the shear, edges become rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with s/W<m^tau gives e^tau. The only gaps are that h=100, the formula for N, and log m<20 are not written out.
